title: Enforce review authority and preserve explicit corrections

intent.outcome: Make the implementing route non-authoritative under human/independent review policy and preserve explicit human corrections through trusted host custody to an owner-appropriate disposition even when the corrected agent takes no correction action.
non_goals: Do not intercept arbitrary out-of-band GitHub operations.
Do not hard-code human review for policies that explicitly permit another verifier class.
Do not create a parallel review framework, correction ledger, or unconditional Memory policy store.
Leave decision-packet budgets, proof execution, external continuity, and dogfooding-signal changes to later lane slices.

parent.contribution: Establish the authority and correction-custody invariants on which every later lane slice and final supported-host replay depends.

owned: AW role/effect routing and maintainer skill eligibility for protected review actions
repo-owned review-marker and merge-gate provenance admission
trusted correction observation, normalization, deduplication, disposition routing, and closeout projection
focused runtime, contract, fixture, documentation, and release-note surfaces required by #2725 and #2726
effects: Implementation-side status remains non-authoritative and routes to ready-for-re-review wording.
Self-authored approval evidence cannot satisfy human/independent review even through owner credentials.
An unresolved trusted correction blocks silent clean closeout until normalized, routed, or explicitly dismissed.
No-correction and policies allowing same-agent/automated review remain quiet and preserve configured semantics.

claims: The implementation route cannot satisfy a configured human/independent review gate with its own evidence, including through owner credentials.
Valid current-head configured review still satisfies the gate and explicitly allowed same-agent/automated policies retain their semantics.
A trusted host can preserve and deduplicate an explicit human correction without corrected-agent cooperation.
Unresolved correction custody produces one exact disposition action and blocks silent clean closeout, while no-correction work stays quiet.
Owner-appropriate disposition reuses existing review/guidance/Memory/improvement owners and makes no duplicate policy record.
requirements: Run focused runtime tests for review authority, marker admission, correction-event ingress, normalization/disposition, startup, and closeout.
Run the repo review-gate fixture with implementing and independent actors sharing and not sharing GitHub association classes.
Run routed Agentic Workspace proof for every changed path and the relevant workspace CLI invariant subset.
Record a maintained host replay covering zero correction-specific agent actions and a no-signal quiet counterexample.
